title: 第17章 玩家的自我养成第18章 灵泉开路
lines: 【恭喜你完成隐藏探索任务：发现未知筑基修士洞府】
【奖励门派贡献点+1000】
姜望这时候又是通过任务系统向莽穿地球编辑发送了一条额外的探索任务奖励。
“一……一千点？”
莽穿地球先是一怔，随即狂喜，乐得嘴巴都快咧到耳根了。
这可比辛辛苦苦建房子，清理废墟，甚至猎杀猛兽来得快太多了。
姜望负手而立，语气平静却自带威严的解释道：
“这一处前人遗留的洞府，即便暂时无法开启，其潜在价值，无论是其中可能遗留的功法、丹药、法宝、典籍，还是它本身作为未来仙门的一处别府或秘境的潜力，都远非半灵之物的清灵泉可比，这1000贡献点，是你应得之赏。”
这番话，不仅是对莽穿地球的肯定。
更是说给旁边眼巴巴看着的剑斩红尘和琉璃仙梦听的。
离去前。
三人用姜望提前准备好的一些小瓶容器，装了满满许多瓶的清灵泉水。
然后刚回到仙门据点，姜望就将三人召至身前，说道：
“本座需外出一趟，采购一些仙门所需物资，短则三两日，长则五六日必回。”
他目光扫过三人，最后落在莽穿地球身上，特意叮嘱道：
“在此期间，尔等切莫要远离此地，若需在周边活动，务必结伴而行，由莽穿地球带队，他如今实力最强，经验也最丰富，遇事更能应对，切记，安全第一，不可贪功冒进，尤其是那处洞府，绝不可再靠近。”
“谨遵门主吩咐！”
三人齐声应道。
交代完毕，姜望不再多言。
周身淡金色光芒一闪，便已化作一道细微金线，冲天而起，瞬息间消失在东方天际，速度之快，令人瞠目。
目送姜望离去，三人收回目光，气氛顿时活跃起来。
话题自然而然地回到了莽穿地球那惊人的收获上。
“老莽，你这运气真是没谁了！”
琉璃仙梦羡慕地说道：“探索一趟，又是灵泉，又是洞府，贡献点直接拿到手软。”
剑斩红尘眼中闪烁着分析的光芒，接话道：
“关键是，他完成的这些，根本不是任务板上列出的内容，无论是灵泉还是洞府，都是完全超出既定范围的隐藏内容！”
剑斩红尘的声音提高了几分，带着发现新大陆般的兴奋：
“你们知道这意味着什么吗？”
莽穿地球和琉璃仙梦都看向他。
content_en:
[Congratulations on completing the hidden exploration mission: discovering the unknown foundation-building monk cave]
[Reward sect contribution points +1000]
At this time, Jiang Wang sent an additional exploration mission reward to the editor of Mangchuan Earth through the mission system.
"One...a thousand points?"
Mang Chuo Earth was startled at first, and then he was ecstatic, so happy that his mouth almost reached his ears.
This is much faster than the hard work of building a house, cleaning up ruins, or even hunting wild beasts.
Jiang Wang stood with his hands behind his back and explained in a calm but dignified tone:
"Even if this cave left by our predecessors cannot be opened for the time being, its potential value, whether it is the skills, elixirs, magic weapons, and classics that may be left behind, or its potential as a villa or secret realm for the future immortal sect, is far from comparable to the Qingling Spring of a semi-spiritual thing. These 1,000 contribution points are the reward you deserve."
These words are not only an affirmation of Mangchuan Earth.
He even told it to Jian Zhan Hongchen and Liuli Xianmeng who were watching eagerly.
Before leaving.
The three of them filled many bottles of Qingling Spring water with some small containers prepared by Jiang Wang in advance.
Then as soon as he returned to the Xianmen stronghold, Jiang Wang summoned the three of them to him and said:
"I need to go out on a trip to purchase some supplies needed by the Immortal Sect. It may take as short as three or two days, or as long as five or six days."
His eyes swept across the three of them, and finally landed on Mang Chuan Earth, and he specifically warned:
"During this period, you must not stay away from this place. If you need to move around, you must go together. The team will be led by Mang Chuanchuan Earth. He is now the strongest and has the most experience. He is better able to deal with situations. Remember, safety comes first, and you must not rush in because of greed. Especially that cave, you must never get closer."
"I will obey the instructions of the sect master!"
The three of them responded in unison.
After the explanation was completed, Jiang Wang said no more.
With a flash of pale golden light around him, it turned into a fine golden thread, soared into the sky, and disappeared into the eastern sky in an instant. The speed was eye-popping.
After watching Jiang Wang leave, the three of them looked away, and the atmosphere suddenly became lively.
The topic naturally returned to the amazing harvest of Mang Chuan Earth.
"Old Mang, you are so lucky!"
Liuli Xianmeng said enviously: "After exploring, there are spiritual springs and caves. The contribution points can be easily obtained."
Jianzhan Hongchen's eyes flashed with analytical light, and he continued:
"The key point is that what he completed is not at all what is listed on the mission board. Whether it is the spiritual spring or the cave, they are all hidden content that is completely beyond the established scope!"
Jian Zhan Hongchen's voice rose a bit, with the excitement of discovering a new world:
"Do you know what this means?"
Both Mangchuan Earth and Liuli Xianmeng looked at him.
title_en: Chapter 17 Player’s self-development Chapter 18 Spiritual spring opens the way
